name: Script validator + topic experiment tracker
goal: Add pre-editing script validation gate (Stage 6-validate) and topic experiment tracking (Stage 9-experiment) to maximize QC pass rate and identify winning content categories before Phase 1.5 kill switch evaluation

tasks.title: Script quality validator — pre-editing gate
tasks.description: CREATE agents/scs001-script-validator/index.ts. ScriptValidator class with validate(bundle: ScriptBundle): ValidationResult. Checks: hook voiceover_text length > 10, segments.length 5-6, pattern_interrupts.length >= 8, total_duration_seconds 24-28. Logs failures to workspace/scs001/validation-errors.jsonl.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: validate() returns correct valid/invalid. Errors logged to JSONL. No external deps.

tasks.title: Wire validator + experiment tracker into orchestrator
tasks.description: MODIFY agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts. Add Stage 6-validate (after 5.5-score, before 6-editing) using ScriptValidator. Add Stage 9-experiment (after 8-qc) using ExperimentTracker to log hook_formula, speaker, qc_passed per gate.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Two new stages in pipeline report. Invalid bundles filtered. Experiments logged. Smoke test PASS.

tasks.title: Topic experiment tracker
tasks.description: CREATE agents/scs001-experiment/index.ts. ExperimentTracker class. logExperiment(entry): appends to experiments.jsonl. getTopPerformers(n=5): top topics by pass_rate. getFormulaStats(): per-formula stats.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: logExperiment appends JSONL. getTopPerformers sorted. Missing file returns empty. No external deps.

tasks.title: Experiments dashboard parser
tasks.description: CREATE dashboard/parsers/experiments.py. get_experiment_stats() reads experiments.jsonl, returns total_logged, top_formulas by pass_rate. get_experiment_history(limit=50) returns last N entries. Handle missing file.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Correct aggregations. Missing file returns safe defaults. Import OK.
